instructions: Tools for retrieving US weather forecasts, observations, alerts, and text products from the National Weather Service (weather.gov). Most location-based tools accept latitude/longitude and internally resolve NWS grid/office identifiers, so agents never need to know about grids, WFOs, or zones directly. Use get_forecast for a human-readable forecast, get_current_observations for the latest reported conditions near a point, get_active_alerts for hazards, and get_text_product for official bulletins.

secrets.description: Identifies the application to the NWS API; should include an app name and contact email.
Optional API key for endpoints testing the newer key-based access system.

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: Gets the multi-day textual weather forecast (e.g. 'Tonight', 'Monday', 'Monday Night') for a US latitude/longitude point. Use this for general 'what's the weather going to be like' questions covering the next 7 days. Not for hour-by-hour detail (use get_hourly_forecast) and not for current conditions (use get_current_observations). Returns a list of forecast periods with temperature, wind, and short/detailed narrative descriptions.

args.name: latitude
args.description: Latitude of the location in decimal degrees.

args.name: longitude
args.description: Longitude of the location in decimal degrees.

args.name: units
args.description: Unit system for the textual output: 'us' (customary, default) or 'si' (metric).

tools.returns: List of forecast periods (name, temperature, wind, short/detailed forecast text) for the given point.

tools.name: get_hourly_forecast
tools.description: Gets the hour-by-hour weather forecast for a US latitude/longitude point, typically covering the next 1-2 days. Use this when an agent needs fine-grained timing (e.g. 'will it rain at 3pm today') rather than the daily-period forecast from get_forecast. Returns a list of hourly periods with start/end times, temperature, and short forecast text.

args.name: latitude
args.description: Latitude of the location in decimal degrees.

args.name: longitude
args.description: Longitude of the location in decimal degrees.

args.name: units
args.description: Unit system for the textual output: 'us' (customary, default) or 'si' (metric).

tools.returns: List of hourly forecast periods (start/end time, temperature, wind, short forecast text) for the given point.

tools.name: get_current_observations
tools.description: Gets the most recent weather observation (temperature, wind, humidity, pressure, textual description) from the observation station nearest a US latitude/longitude point. Use this for 'what's the weather right now' questions. Not for forecasts.

args.name: latitude
args.description: Latitude of the location in decimal degrees.

args.name: longitude
args.description: Longitude of the location in decimal degrees.

tools.returns: Latest observation for the nearest station: timestamp, temperature, wind, humidity, pressure, and textual description.

tools.name: get_active_alerts
tools.description: Gets currently active weather alerts (watches, warnings, advisories) for a US state/territory code, marine area, or a specific latitude/longitude point. Use this to check for hazardous weather conditions. Provide either area or a point, not both. Returns a list of active alerts with event type, severity, headline, and description.

args.name: area
args.description: Two-letter US state/territory code or marine area code (e.g. 'CA', 'TX', 'GM'). Comma-separated for multiple.

args.name: point
args.description: Latitude,longitude pair (e.g. '39.7456,-97.0892') to find alerts covering that location.

tools.returns: List of active alert features, each with properties like event, severity, headline, description, and affected area.

tools.name: get_alert_details
tools.description: Gets full details for a single weather alert by its unique alert ID (as returned in get_active_alerts results). Use this when an agent already has an alert ID and needs the complete record, including affected zones and references. Not for searching alerts.

args.name: alert_id
args.description: The unique identifier of the alert.

tools.returns: Full alert record including area description, affected zones, timing, status, and message type.

tools.name: get_text_product
tools.description: Gets the full text of a specific NWS text product bulletin (e.g. area forecast discussion, special weather statement) by its product ID. Use this when an agent already has a product ID, such as from get_latest_text_product. Returns the raw issuing office, timing metadata, and full product text.

args.name: product_id
args.description: The unique identifier of the text product.

tools.returns: Text product record with issuing office, issuance time, product code/name, and full product text.

tools.name: get_latest_text_product
tools.description: Gets the most recently issued text product of a given type (e.g. 'AFD' for Area Forecast Discussion, 'SPS' for Special Weather Statement) for a given NWS issuance location (typically a 3-letter office/station code). Use this to get the current forecast discussion or statement for an office without knowing specific product IDs. Returns the full product text.

args.name: product_type
args.description: Product type code, e.g. 'AFD' (Area Forecast Discussion), 'SPS' (Special Weather Statement), 'ZFP' (Zone Forecast Product).

args.name: location_id
args.description: NWS issuance location code, typically the 3-letter forecast office or station identifier (e.g. 'OKX').

tools.returns: The latest text product for the given type and location, including full product text.
